propositions.claim: The held text is the Federal Register printing of EO 11256 at 30 FR 14137, issue of November 10, 1965.
propositions.quote: THE PRESIDENT 14137 Executive Order 11256 ESTABLISHING THE PRESIDENT'S COMMITTEE ON FOOD AND FIBER AND THE NATIONAL ADVISORY COMMISSION ON FOOD AND FIBER

propositions.claim: Sec. 1 establishes the Committee.
propositions.quote: There is hereby established the President's Committee on Food and Fiber

propositions.claim: Sec. 2 gives the Committee appraisal and recommendation duties.
propositions.quote: Appraise existing and alternative agricultural policies and foreign trade policies related thereto in terms of the national interest

propositions.claim: Sec. 3 establishes the Commission to assist the Committee.
propositions.quote: there is hereby established the National Advisory Commission on Food and Fiber

propositions.claim: Sec. 4 requires the Commission's final report within eighteen months of its first meeting (a reporting deadline, not itself a termination).
propositions.quote: The Commission shall submit its final report and recommendations to the Committee no later than eighteen months after the date of its first meeting

propositions.claim: Sec. 5 designates GSA to provide administrative services and authorizes agency information and assistance.
propositions.quote: The General Services Administration is hereby designated as the agency which shall, on a reimbursable basis, provide administrative services for the Commission.

propositions.claim: Sec. 6 ends both bodies ninety days after the submission of the Commission's final report. Neither of the two files read (the EO 11256 and EO 12379 Federal Register extracts) gives the date of that submission; no other file was searched for it.
propositions.quote: The Committee and the Commission shall terminate ninety days after the submission of the final report of the Commission.

propositions.claim: EO 12379 sec. 18 expressly revokes EO 11256 by number and title.
propositions.quote: Sec. 18. Executive Order No. 11256, establishing the President's Committee on Food and Fiber and establishing the National Advisory Commission on Food and Fiber, is revoked.

propositions.claim: EO 12379 is dated August 17, 1982 and printed at 47 FR 36099-36100.
propositions.quote: Executive Order 12379 of August 17, 1982 The President Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions

propositions.claim: EO 12379 was issued to end the establishing authorities of inactive committees; its text runs to sec. 25 and the signature with no savings clause.
propositions.quote: to terminate the establishing authorities for committees that are inactive or no longer necessary, it is hereby ordered as follows

propositions.claim: Sec. 7 performs a one-time revocation of two earlier orders, completed by the order itself.
propositions.quote: Executive Order 10472 of July 20, 1953, and Executive Order 10937 of May 3, 1961, are hereby revoked.

propositions.claim: The order was filed with the Federal Register on November 9, 1965; the signature line's day is OCR-damaged, and the project dates the order 1965-11-04.

review.conclusion_reason: The express, unqualified revocation in EO 12379 section 18 establishes NO operative status at the cutoff and formal revocation, no later than August 17, 1982. Section 7's revocations were spent on issuance. The report-submission date could establish an earlier termination of the bodies but is unnecessary to this bounded conclusion.

verdicts.reason: The held official-PDF extract identifies EO 11256, page 14137, and the November 10, 1965 Federal Register issue; the title matches after OCR normalization.
Section 1(a) expressly establishes the President's Committee on Food and Fiber.
Section 2(a)(1) contains the quoted appraisal duty; subsection (2) requires development of recommendations.
Section 3(a) expressly establishes the Commission to assist the Committee.
Section 4(c) requires the final report and recommendations no later than eighteen months after the first meeting. This is a reporting deadline, not itself termination.
Section 5(c) contains the quoted GSA designation; sections 5(a)-(b) authorize information and require departmental assistance subject to their stated conditions.

Section 6 confirms termination ninety days after submission of the final report. Neither reviewed official extract supplies that submission date, but the claim that it appears in no held file exceeds what these cited files establish.
EO 12379 section 18 states: 'Executive Order No. 11256, establishing the President’s Committee on Food and Fiber and establishing the National Advisory Commission on Food and Fiber, is revoked.'
The heading and closing date identify August 17, 1982; the two extracted pages are numbered 36099 and 36100 in volume 47.
The preamble contains the quoted purpose. The complete extracted order proceeds through section 25 and its closing block without a savings clause.
Section 7 states that Executive Orders 10472 and 10937 'are hereby revoked,' performing the one-time act on issuance.
The filing notation matches November 9, 1965, at 9:39 a.m.; the extracted signature date reads 'November J, 1965.' The supplied evidence slice gives the project date as November 4, 1965.
